title: Universal Date & Calendar Converter
subtitle: Instant three-way synchronization across Solar Hijri, Gregorian, and Lunar Hijri calendars.

overview.heroSubtitle: Convert dates instantaneously between Solar Hijri (Jalali), Gregorian, and Lunar Hijri calendars with 100% mathematical precision. All calculations execute locally inside your browser memory with zero tracking, zero server queries, and complete offline capability.

cards.title: 100% Private & Local
cards.description: Your calendar calculations remain 100% confined to your device browser memory. Zero queries, timestamps, or IP metadata are ever transmitted to any cloud backend.

cards.title: Real-Time 3-Way Sync
cards.description: Altering year, month, or day in any calendar triggers an instant, deterministic recalculation of all three calendars via optimized Julian Day Number (JDN) algorithms.

cards.title: Astronomical Leap Accuracy
cards.description: Full support for the official 33-year astronomical leap cycle for Solar Hijri, Gregorian leap rules, and Lunar Hijri Umm al-Qura standard calculations.

items.title: Solar Hijri (Jalali)
items.description: Official astronomical solar calendar of Iran and Afghanistan based on the vernal equinox.

items.title: Gregorian Calendar
items.description: Internationally accepted civil calendar standard adhering to ISO 8601 specifications.

items.title: Lunar Hijri Calendar
items.description: Pure lunar calendar based on the synodic lunar cycle and Umm al-Qura astronomical standard.

faq.title: Calendar Converter FAQ
faq.subtitle: Direct, factual answers regarding astronomical algorithms, client-side date synchronization, and multi-calendar standards.

items.question: Is the date conversion performed entirely in my browser?
items.answer: Yes, 100%. The date converter uses deterministic astronomical algorithms and standard client-side browser Intl APIs. Zero date queries, location metrics, or timestamps are ever transmitted to any remote server or external API.

items.question: How accurate are the Solar Hijri (Jalali) and Lunar Hijri conversions?
items.answer: The Jalali calendar engine implements the official astronomical 33-year leap cycle algorithm with 100% precision for historical, present, and future dates. The Lunar Hijri calendar adheres to the Umm al-Qura standard via high-precision client-side astronomical calculation.

items.question: How does the converter calculate and display leap years?
items.answer: Leap years are dynamically calculated in real time across all three calendars simultaneously. When an active year is a leap year (kabiseh in Jalali / leap in Gregorian / kabisa in Hijri), a dedicated badge appears instantly on the respective card and in the detailed metrics section.

items.question: Can I step dates forwards and backwards with one click?
items.answer: Yes. Each calendar panel includes stepper controls for incrementing and decrementing days, quick-select dropdown menus for months and days, direct numeric year editing, and a universal Today reset button.
